APP CONTEXT: the Kaymo site is a STATIC site at `/var/www/kaymo` on the server 51.79.226.215 (Prisma `server` id `cmsecmdps0001hlp27ai6mr7c`, name "nexis-app"), served by nginx vhost `/etc/nginx/conf.d/kaymo-revsports.conf` at https://kaymo.revsports.ca (HTTPS live). SSH access: read that server row, password = `decryptSecret(rootPasswordEnc)` (lib/crypto-box.ts), ssh2 as root — ASSERT ip==51.79.226.215 first. DB access for board cards is via Prisma (nxeon DB) on THIS host.

BOARD DATA: find the board (name contains "Kaymo"). Columns: Ideas / Backlog / In progress / Review / Done. Work ONLY the 2 cards currently in **Ideas**: "Image missing" and "contact form". Read each card fully — title, description, comments, and any attachments (on disk at `/opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/<cardId>/<storedName>`; read images/PDFs to understand). Do NOT touch cards already in Review/Done.

FOR EACH Ideas card:
1. `db.card.update` move it to the "In progress" column + `db.cardComment.create({authorName:"Claude", body:"starting…"})`.
2. Do the real work on the static site (edit files in a local working copy, then rsync to `/var/www/kaymo` on .215 via box-side `sshpass -f` + rsync; shred the pw file after). This is a brand-new static site with no real traffic, so you MAY deploy these small fixes live.
3. Verify (curl https://kaymo.revsports.ca/... or host-header on the box).
4. Move the card to "Review" (or "Done" if fully complete + verified and needs no user decision) with a thorough comment: what you changed, the result, and anything the user must decide (e.g. a real contact-form endpoint).

CARD NOTES:
- "contact form": the form currently POSTs to a Formspree PLACEHOLDER with a mailto:kbamvideo@gmail.com fallback. Read the card for what the user wants. If they didn't provide a real endpoint, make the mailto fallback robust and leave the card in Review noting an endpoint is still needed — don't invent a fake endpoint.
- "Image missing": read the card + any attachment; a real image may be attached to add, or one may be broken. Fix on the static site.

CONSTRAINTS: only touch `/var/www/kaymo` + its nginx vhost on .215. Do NOT touch /opt/nexis, the Soul Pilates .200 box, /opt/nxeon, DNS, or other apps. If a card is ambiguous or needs info you don't have, comment your interpretation + leave it in Review rather than guessing. If a classifier blocks a command, report it and continue.

Return: per card — what you did + its new column + comment summary.

model Board {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  appId     String?
  app       App?          @relation(fields: [appId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  columns   BoardColumn[]
  cards     Card[]

  @@index([appId])
}

model BoardColumn {
  id       String  @id @default(cuid())
  boardId  String
  board    Board   @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name     String
  position Int     @default(0)
  cards    Card[]

  @@index([boardId])
}

model Card {
  id          String           @id @default(cuid())
  boardId     String
  board       Board            @relation(fields: [boardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  columnId    String
  column      BoardColumn      @relation(fields: [columnId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title       String
  description String           @default("") // markdown
  type        CardType         @default(FEATURE)
  priority    CardPriority     @default(NORMAL)
  labels      String[]         @default([])
  assignee    String? // free-text ("me", "claude", a name)
  position    Int              @default(0)
  archivedAt  DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime         @updatedAt
  attachments CardAttachment[]
  comments    CardComment[]

  @@index([boardId])
  @@index([columnId])
}

model CardAttachment {
  id         String         @id @default(cuid())
  cardId     String
  card       Card           @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  filename   String // original name shown to the user
  storedName String // on-disk name (uuid + ext) under the board upload dir
  mime       String         @default("application/octet-stream")
  sizeBytes  Int            @default(0)
  kind       AttachmentKind @default(FILE)
  createdAt  DateTime       @default(now())

  @@index([cardId])
}

model CardComment {

  cardId     String
  card       Card     @relation(fields: [cardId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorName String   @default("")
  body       String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([cardId])
